name: @veren/auth-core
description: Use when a host application needs an embeddable authentication framework per plugins/auth/design: it assembles config, secrets, table models and extensions into one shared runtime context, routes every capability through a guarded endpoint pipeline (origin check, rate limit, session middlewares, before/after hooks), and owns the identity, credential and session authorities over a @veren/orm-backed adapter with atomic consume/increment primitives; skip it when a hosted auth service already answers sign-in and session calls for the app.
